# Manifest FTS

> Manifest FTS is an engineering-led digital partner that designs, builds, and supports durable web platforms, secure infrastructure, and practical technology strategy.

Manifest FTS focuses on three operating principles: trusted technology partnership, data trust and security, and appropriate technology. We connect product discovery, accessible UX, full-stack engineering, managed infrastructure, and ongoing support so organizations can make informed decisions about their digital systems.

## Core services
- [Services overview](https://www.manifestfts.com/services): Product design and UX engineering, full-stack web development, managed infrastructure and data trust, and AI search and citation optimization.
- [Product design and UX engineering](https://www.manifestfts.com/services#product-design): Human-centered, accessible digital product design and front-end engineering.
- [Full-stack web development](https://www.manifestfts.com/services#web-development): Modern CMS, headless platforms, commerce, integrations, and custom web applications.
- [Managed infrastructure and data trust](https://www.manifestfts.com/services#infrastructure): Hosting, domain governance, access reviews, backup planning, and ongoing technical stewardship.
- [AI search and citation optimization](https://www.manifestfts.com/services#signal): Evidence-led answer-engine visibility and citation work. Manifest Signal is an in-development product concept; sample dashboards are illustrative, not live provider data.

## Selected work
- [NC Waterfalls](https://www.manifestfts.com/case-study/nc-waterfalls): Searchable archive built from decades of North Carolina waterfall fieldwork. Published launch figures are historical snapshots and are labeled on the case study.
- [Barclay Rex](https://www.manifestfts.com/case-study/barclay-rex): Long-running digital commerce and platform modernization partnership.
- [Community Coalition on Race](https://www.communitycoalitiononrace.org/): Mission-focused digital outreach and NationBuilder platform work.
- [Garden State Equality](https://www.gardenstateequality.org/): Managed WordPress hosting and digital strategy.
- [Selected client stories](https://www.manifestfts.com/work): Story summaries, documented evidence, and metric context.

## Measurement notes
Metrics shown in interactive previews are illustrative. Citation visibility, competitive share of voice, sentiment, accuracy, and business outcomes are distinct measures; any reported result should name its sample, denominator, method, date range, and source. A crawler being able to access a site does not guarantee that a system indexes, cites, or recommends it.
